title: Legora raises $550 million at an $8.8 billion valuation
friendlyTitle: Legora raises $550 million for legal agents
summary: Legora, which sells an agentic workspace for lawyers, says it has raised a $550 million Series E at an $8.8 billion post-money valuation. The round was led by Atreides Management, with new money from Baron, Capital Group, Fidelity, Glade Brook, and J.P. Morgan, and with every major existing investor participating. Legora says annual recurring revenue is now above $200 million, that it went from $1 million to $100 million in under 18 months, and that the next $100 million took under six months. It says in-house legal teams were more than 40% of new customers in the third quarter, and that more than half of the Am Law 50 are customers. The previous round was at $5.6 billion.

whyItMatters: Those growth figures are the company's. The practical signal is that a legal agent product is being bought by in-house teams, not only by firms, and that the buyers in this round include institutions that already sit next to those teams. A tool that drafts the first pass still leaves the judgment, and the client relationship, with the lawyer.
